signature.name: VTask.noncommFoldr
signature.type: {α : Type u_3} -> {β : Type u_4} -> (f : α → β → β) -> (s : Multiset α) -> (comm : {x | x ∈ s}.Pairwise fun x y => ∀ (b : β), f x (f y b) = f y (f x b)) -> (b : β) -> β

conventions.statement: When `s = 0` (the empty multiset), `VTask.noncommFoldr f 0 h b = b` for any `f`, `h`, and `b`.
When `s` is a list `l` coerced to a multiset, `VTask.noncommFoldr f ↑l comm b = List.foldr f b l`.
When `LeftCommutative f` holds globally, `VTask.noncommFoldr f s _ b` equals `Multiset.foldr f b s`.

facts.statement: example : VTask.noncommFoldr (fun (n : ℕ) acc => n + acc) (0 : Multiset ℕ) (by simp [Set.Pairwise]) 7 = 7 := by decide

facts.violated_property: folding empty multiset must return initial accumulator b (= 7), not 0

facts.statement: ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (h : Set.Pairwise {x | x ∈ (0 : Multiset ℕ)} (fun x y => ∀ b, f x (f y b) = f y (f x b))) (b : ℕ), VTask.noncommFoldr f (0 : Multiset ℕ) h b = b

facts.statement: ∀ (l : List ℕ) (comm : Set.Pairwise {x | x ∈ (↑l : Multiset ℕ)} (fun x y => ∀ b, (· + ·) x ((· + ·) y b) = (· + ·) y ((· + ·) x b))) (b : ℕ), VTask.noncommFoldr (· + ·) (↑l : Multiset ℕ) comm b = l.foldr (· + ·) b

facts.statement: ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (s : Multiset ℕ) (a : ℕ) (h : Set.Pairwise {x | x ∈ a ::ₘ s} (fun x y => ∀ b, f x (f y b) = f y (f x b))) (h' : Set.Pairwise {x | x ∈ s} (fun x y => ∀ b, f x (f y b) = f y (f x b))) (b : ℕ), VTask.noncommFoldr f (a ::ₘ s) h b = f a (VTask.noncommFoldr f s h' b)

facts.statement: ∀ (f : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) [h : LeftCommutative f] (s : Multiset ℕ) (b : ℕ), VTask.noncommFoldr f s (fun x _ y _ _ => h.left_comm x y) b = Multiset.foldr f b s

facts.statement: ∀ {α β : Type} (f : α → β → β) (a : α) (h : Set.Pairwise {x | x ∈ ({a} : Multiset α)} (fun x y => ∀ b, f x (f y b) = f y (f x b))) (b : β), VTask.noncommFoldr f {a} h b = f a b
